senses.sense_definition: Awkward or lacking in social graces; bumbling; apt to make gaffes.

examples.text: It felt <w>gauche</w> to ask about his salary during our very first meeting.
His <w>gauche</w> behavior at the formal dinner party made everyone feel quite uncomfortable.

senses.sense_definition: Skewed or not lying in a single plane.

examples.text: The two lines in three-dimensional space are <w>gauche</w> because they are neither parallel nor intersecting.
In geometry, a <w>gauche</w> quadrilateral is one whose vertices do not all lie in the same plane.

senses.sense_definition: Describing a molecular conformation with a torsion angle of approximately 60 degrees.

examples.text: The <w>gauche</w> conformation of butane is less stable than the anti conformation due to steric hindrance.
Chemists often analyze the <w>gauche</w> interaction between substituents on adjacent carbon atoms.
